Assumptions, since this run doesn't allow questions:
- **Image model:** Any current model will work. The prompts are written in plain language for GPT-image, Imagen, Flux or Gemini. I've added Midjourney and SDXL settings where they differ.
- **Look:** I set fixed values for Narine's appearance (hair, eye color, glasses, mole, outfit). Change any of them once, before you generate anything, then never change them afterward. Consistency depends on those values staying the same in every prompt.
- **Workflow:** Generate the turnaround sheet first. Pick the best result and use it as your image reference (for example, `--cref`/`--oref`, IP-Adapter, or "use attached image as character reference") for every later shot.

## FINAL

### 1. Character lock block (paste into every prompt, word-for-word)

```
Narine, a 41-year-old Armenian woman, 165 cm, average build with slightly rounded shoulders from desk work. Oval face, defined straight nose with a slight bump at the bridge, strong dark eyebrows that are naturally full but neatly shaped, deep-set dark brown eyes with faint shadows and fine lines at the outer corners — tired but sharp, alert, observant gaze. Light olive skin with a few visible pores and faint smile lines; a small mole on the left cheekbone. Thick dark brown hair with a few visible grey strands at the temples, shoulder-length, worn in a low loose bun with a few strands falling out. Thin rectangular tortoiseshell reading glasses (often pushed up on the head or held in hand). Minimal makeup. Small gold stud earrings, a thin gold chain with a tiny pomegranate pendant, a plain silver wristwatch on the left wrist.
Outfit: charcoal-grey straight-leg wool trousers, cream-colored knit sweater with a crew neck over a white collared shirt (collar visible), navy single-breasted blazer, black low-heeled leather loafers, a lanyard with a company ID badge.
```

### 2. Main reference sheet (turnaround)

```
Character reference sheet, model sheet layout on a plain light-grey studio background, same character shown in four full-body views side by side: front view, three-quarter view, side profile, back view, plus two head-and-shoulders close-ups (front and three-quarter) in the top corner. Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed, neutral expression with a faint tired half-smile.
[CHARACTER LOCK BLOCK]
Photorealistic, contemporary 2026 setting, soft even studio lighting, no dramatic shadows, true-to-life skin texture, consistent proportions and identical outfit in every view, clean evenly spaced layout, no text, no labels, no watermark.
```

### 3. Expression sheet

```
Character expression sheet, 3x2 grid of head-and-shoulders portraits of the same woman on a plain light-grey background, identical lighting and framing in each cell. Expressions: (1) neutral, focused; (2) tired, rubbing the bridge of her nose with glasses in hand; (3) dry, skeptical raised eyebrow; (4) warm genuine smile; (5) concentrated, reading with glasses on, lips slightly pressed; (6) mid-sentence explaining something, one hand raised.
[CHARACTER LOCK BLOCK]
Photorealistic, 2026, soft diffused light, consistent face, hair and outfit across all six, no text.
```

### 4. Detail and props sheet

```
Detail reference sheet on a neutral grey background, flat-lay and close-up studies: tortoiseshell rectangular reading glasses, thin gold chain with tiny pomegranate pendant, small gold stud earring, plain silver wristwatch, company ID badge on lanyard, black low-heeled loafers, navy blazer fabric and cream knit sweater texture, a worn hardcover English–Armenian dictionary full of sticky notes, a laptop with a translation document open. Photorealistic product-style photography, even lighting, no text.
```

### 5. Template for each scene shot

```
[SHOT TYPE: e.g. medium shot / close-up / wide shot], [SCENE: e.g. Narine at her desk in an open-plan office in Yerevan, late afternoon, translating a contract on a laptop, glasses on, a cooling cup of coffee beside her].
[CHARACTER LOCK BLOCK]
Same character as reference image. Photorealistic, 2026, [LIGHTING: e.g. natural window light mixed with cool office fluorescents], 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural color grade.
```

### Negative prompt (SDXL/Flux/Leonardo)

```
young, teenage, glamour makeup, heavy contouring, airbrushed skin, cartoon, anime, illustration, extra fingers, deformed hands, different outfit, different hairstyle, blonde hair, colored eyes, text, watermark, logo, cropped head, multiple different people
```

### Settings
- **Aspect ratio:** 16:9 or 3:2 for the turnaround, 3:2 for expressions, and whatever your scene needs for shots.
- **Midjourney (v7):** `--ar 16:9 --style raw --s 50`. For scenes, add `--oref [sheet URL] --ow 100–200` (or `--cref --cw 100` on V6). Use `--cw 0` only when you want her face kept but her outfit changed.
- **SDXL/Flux:** CFG 4–6 (Flux guidance about 3), 30–40 steps. Use an IP-Adapter FaceID or PuLID weight of 0.6–0.8 with the chosen close-up. If you'll make many shots, train a small LoRA on 15–20 of the best sheet crops.
- **Seed:** Lock one seed for the sheets. Change the seed between scenes and let the reference image hold her identity.
- **Consistency rules:** Never change the lock block. Change her look only by adding a line to the scene section (for example, "blazer removed, sleeves pushed up"). Keep a written list of any changes you approve.
